cards.audioText: Your call sign is SIA852, you are at Wuhan Airport, stand 7, received ATIS M, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是新航852，你现在在武汉机场，7号停机位，收到机场通播M，请求飞往新加坡的放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA852, Stand 7, Information M, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新加坡852，停机位7号，通播M，请求飞往新加坡的放行许可。

cards.audioText: SIA852, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, ZF 03D departure, initial climb to 1800m, cruising level 10400m, RWY 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航852，可以经由计划航路飞往新加坡，ZF03离场（程序），初始爬升高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道18左，离场频率124.7，应答机4615。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, ZF 03D departure, initial 1800m, cruising level 10400m, RWY 18L, contact 124.7, squawk 4615, SIA852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往新加坡，ZF03离场（程序），初始爬升高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道18左，离场频率124.7，应答机4615，新航852。

cards.audioText: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你准备好推出开车了，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航852，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText:
SIA852, delay for push back and start up due flow control.
[Read back the instruction and ask how long the delay will be.]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航852，由于流控，推迟推出开车。
[复诵信息，并询问延误时间多久。]
cards.referenceText: Delay for push back and start up due flow control. How long is the delay? SIA852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于流控，推迟推出开车，延误多久？新航852。

cards.audioText: SIA852, delay about a few minutes.
A few minutes later, contact Ground and request a new clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 几分钟后，联系地面，请求新的许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航852，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: SIA852, push back and start up at your own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航852，自行决定推出开车。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up at own discretion, SIA852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自行决定推出开车，新航852。

cards.audioText: You have completed the pushback and start up procedure, you decided to make an intersection departure from E2. Contact Ground to request intersection departure from E2.
cards.audioTextZh: 你完成了推出和开车程序，你决定从滑行道E2进行减跑道起飞，联系地面，请求从E2进行减跑道起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, completed pushback and start up. Request intersection departure from E2.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航852，完成推出开车，请求从E2进行减跑道起飞。

cards.audioText: SIA852, intersection departure from E2 is approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2. Hold short of RWY 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航852，可以从E2进行减跑道起飞，经由A6,A,A2，滑行至E2，跑道18左外等待。
cards.referenceText: Intersection departure from E2 is approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2. Hold short of RWY 18L, SIA852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以从E2进行减跑道起飞，经由A6,A,A2，滑行至E2，跑道18左外等待，新航852。

cards.audioText: During taxiing, you find a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, you have stopped the aircraft, inform ATC about this situation and request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
cards.audioTextZh: 在滑行过程中，你发现一辆汽车在滑行道A上抛锚了。你停下了飞机，告知管制员此情况，请求机场服务拖走汽车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, we stopped taxiing due to a vehicle broken down on taxiway, request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航852，滑行道上有汽车抛锚，我们停止滑行，请求机场服务拖走汽车。

cards.audioText: SIA852, hold at present position. The ramp services will be there in a few minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航852，在当前位置等待，机坪服务将在几分钟后到达。

cards.audioText: You are now holding short of RWY 18L on E2. Request for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在滑行道E2，跑道18左外等待，请求起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA852, we are holding short of RWY 18L on E2. Request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航852，我们在滑行道E2，跑道18左外等待，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: During the takeoff roll, your nose wheel ran over a sharp object on the runway surface and a nose wheel tire burst, you aborted takeoff. Notify Wuhan Tower and request fire trucks and maintenance.
cards.audioTextZh: 在起飞滑跑期间，你的前轮碾过跑道表面上的尖锐物，前轮爆胎，你中断起飞了，通知武汉塔台，请求消防车以及机务维修人员。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA852, we aborted takeoff due nose wheel tire burst. Request fire trucks and maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航852，由于前轮爆胎，我们中断起飞了，请求消防车和机务维修人员。

cards.audioText:
SIA852, do you require anything else?
Tell ATC that you require a tug to tow your aircraft back to the apron after inspection.
cards.audioTextZh:
新航852，你还请求别的吗？
[告诉管制员，检查完飞机后，你需要一辆拖车，将飞机拖回机坪]
cards.referenceText: Affirm. Request a tug to tow back to the apron after inspection, SIA852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，检查完飞机后，请求一辆拖车，将飞机拖回机坪，新航852。

cards.audioText: SIA852, the tug is on the way. Contact ground 121.75.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航852，拖车在路上了，联系地面121.75。

cards.audioText: Request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: [请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪待命]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航852，请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪待命。
